answer:
The longest running show in Broadway history is **"The Phantom of the Opera"**, which ran from 1988 until its closure in 2023 after 35 years and nearly 14,000 performances.

This musical is based on the Gothic horror novel **"The Phantom of the Opera"** (originally published as "Le Fantôme de l'Opéra") written by **French author Gaston Leroux**. The novel first appeared as a serialized story in the Parisian newspaper Le Gaulois from September 23, 1909, to August 3, 1910.

Gaston Leroux (1868–1927) was a French journalist and author of detective fiction who gained worldwide fame primarily through this work.
